module: Countdown displayed during the crash test scenario. Each whole second crossed, it sends a message to the UI (ScenarioFlashMessage event) with the remaining digit and a countdown sound, then "Go!" with a start sound when the time is up, and then calls the given callback.
notes: The time decreases with dtSim (simulation time), so it stops when paused.
The message has the form {{text, 0.95, luaCall, true}}; the third element is a Lua call played by the UI (Engine.Audio.playOnce).
The name of the internal function updateCoundown contains a typo (no effect).

startNewCountdown.desc: Starts a countdown of duration seconds. The callback is called when the count reaches 0 (at the time of "Go!").

callback_.desc: Function called at the end of the countdown.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: advances the countdown if one is in progress.
